description:
Activate Giggling Skitterspike using Phyrexian Devourer by exiling the top card of your library, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Giggling Skitterspike equal to the card's mana value.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Declare Giggling Skitterspike as an attacker, triggering its ability, dealing damage equal to its power to each opponent.

uses.name: Giggling Skitterspike
uses.cardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and without summoning sickness
